A '''super restore''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] that restores all player [[stats]] that have been lowered, including [[Prayer]], but not [[Hitpoints]]. Players with level 63 [[Herblore]] can make a super restore potion by using a [[red spiders' eggs]] on a [[snapdragon potion (unf)]], giving 142.5 [[experience]]. Super restores can further be made into [[Sanfew serum]]s by adding (in order) [[unicorn horn dust]], [[snake weed]], and [[nail beast nails]] into a super restore potion.

The restore value obtained per dose is 8 + 25% of the player's base level (rounded down) in each of the affected [[skills]]. For example, a player with 84 [[Thieving]] and 63 [[Smithing]] would restore both 29 points of Thieving and 23 points of Smithing for each dose consumed. The maximum amount of points that can be restored with this potion is 32 at level 96. This means that a super restore potion will restore 1 more Prayer point per dose than a [[prayer potion]].

If a [[Prayer cape]] or [[ring of the gods (i)]] is equipped, or a [[holy wrench]] is in the player's inventory, the ''prayer'' restore increases to 8 + 27% of the player's current Prayer level, rounded down. This does not affect the rate of restoration of stats other than Prayer.

Two 3-dose super restores can be obtained by starting the [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]] [[quest]].

After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]] is completed, [[caviar]] can be added to a super restore(2) to produce a [[super restore mix]]. This requires 67 Herblore and provides 48 Herblore experience. A super restore mix has 2 doses, each of which heals 6 [[Hitpoints]] in addition to the super restore recovery.

Players with level 63 [[Herblore]] can make a super restore potion by using a [[red spiders' eggs]] on a [[snapdragon potion (unf)]], giving 142.5 [[experience]]. Super restores can further be made into [[Sanfew serum]]s by adding (in order) [[unicorn horn dust]], [[snake weed]], and [[nail beast nails]] into a super restore potion.

For example, a player with 84 [[Thieving]] and 63 [[Smithing]] would restore both 29 points of Thieving and 23 points of Smithing for each dose consumed. The maximum amount of points that can be restored with this potion is 32 at level 96. This means that a super restore potion will restore 1 more Prayer point per dose than a [[prayer potion]].
